bills.caption: Relating to the planning for, interconnection and operation of, and costs related to providing service for certain electrical loads and to the generation of electric power by a water supply or sewer service corporation.
bills.author: King | Schwertner
bills.why: Large load law. It drives the large load rulemakings here (Projects 58481 and 58482) and, per Staff's August 13 memo, the transmission cost recovery review (Projects 58484 and 58000).

bills.caption: Relating to the continuation and functions of the Public Utility Commission of Texas and the Office of Public Utility Counsel, and the functions of the independent organization certified for the ERCOT power region; increasing an administrative penalty.
bills.author: Holland | Bell, Keith | Canales | Goldman | Clardy
bills.why: Per Staff's August 13 memo, this 2023 law directed ERCOT to create Dispatchable Reliability Reserve Service, which is still being built out through NPRR1310 and NPRR1340.
